content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:
To make an avocado shake, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Scoop the avocado flesh into a small bowl (45 seconds)
Step 2. Pour the primary avocado mixture into the blender base (10 seconds)
Step 3. Measure out the honey (30 seconds)
Step 4. Wipe down the blender lid (20 seconds)
Step 5. Locate the condensed milk in the pantry (1 minute)
Step 6. Sterilize the serving glasses (5 minutes)
Step 7. Finely chop a few mint leaves for garnish (2 minutes)
Step 8. Set out the decorative straws (15 seconds)
Step 9. Check the expiration date on the milk (10 seconds)
Step 10. Open the can of condensed milk (30 seconds)
Step 11. Rinse the can opener (20 seconds)
Step 12. Prepare a tray for serving (1 minute)
Step 13. Clear a space on the kitchen counter (2 minutes)
Step 14. Wash your hands thoroughly (40 seconds)
Step 15. Pulse the blender on high speed (1 minute)

Step 17. Add a pinch of sea salt to the mix (5 seconds)
Step 18. Place the finished shake on the tray (10 seconds)
Step 19. Pit the avocado (30 seconds)

Step 21. Take the milk out of the refrigerator (15 seconds)

Step 58. Find the recipe book (2 minutes)

Step 61. Add the condensed milk to the blender (20 seconds)

Step 65. Add the milk to the blender (15 seconds)
Step 66. Add the honey to the blender (20 seconds)
Step 67. Gather all necessary tools and utensils (4 minutes)
Step 68. Get the ice hammer (30 seconds)
Step 69. Slice the avocado flesh into chunks (1 minute)
Step 70. Sharpen the chef's knife (5 minutes)
Step 71. Clear the sink (2 minutes)
Step 72. Pour a small amount of water to test the seal (30 seconds)
Step 73. Prepare the spatula for use (15 seconds)
Step 74. Pick the freshest mint leaves (1 minute)
Step 75. Read the label on the condensed milk (15 seconds)
Step 76. Rinse the cleaning cloth (45 seconds)
Step 77. Measure the temperature of the milk (20 seconds)
Step 78. Set the blender speed to "low" (5 seconds)
Step 79. Position the blender on a flat surface (20 seconds)
Step 80. Calibrate the kitchen scale (2 minutes)
Step 81. Ensure the blender is turned off (5 seconds)
Step 82. Dry the cutting board (1 minute)
Step 83. Place the lid on the blender (10 seconds)
Step 84. Add the crushed ice to the blender (20 seconds)
Step 85. Pour the milk into a measuring cup (30 seconds)
Step 86. Prepare the garnishing tools (1 minute)
Step 87. Double check the blender settings (10 seconds)
Step 88. Warm the honey jar in warm water (3 minutes)
Step 89. Measure the avocado chunks (45 seconds)
